n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
k = int(input())

a.sort()

max_count = 1
for j in range(n - 1):
    current_count = 1
    for i in range(j + 1, n):
        if a[i] - a[j] <= k:
            current_count += 1
        else:
            break
    max_count = max(max_count, current_count)
